Marcus / Laura / Elena —

Below are the items we can provide and suggested DPA annex text fragments. I pasted the most relevant excerpts to expedite FinBridge's review.

=== Evidence we will provide (DPF bundle) ===
- Dataflow diagram (processing boundary + egress regions) and list of regional endpoints (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1 for partner-hosted workloads)
- Transfer mechanisms: EU-US DPF mapping + standard contractual clauses (SCCs) example, plus our documented fallback to model variants within the same legal jurisdiction when required
- Operational logs: sample audit log schema (timestamp, request_id, model_variant, region, token_count, redaction_flags) and 90/180-day retention options; logs can be exported on request for audits
- Key management: KMS integration notes and optional customer-managed key (CMK) flow for Private and Dedicated deployments

=== DPA Annex recommended language (excerpt) ===
(1) Routing & Residency
- Processor will route requests according to Customer routing policy; Customer may restrict processing to specified regions. When requested, Processor will pin model execution to the selected residency region and provide evidence of region-bound execution.

(2) Fallbacks & Degradation
- In the event the preferred model or region is unavailable, Processor will: (a) notify Customer via configured webhook or console alert, and (b) apply a pre-approved fallback model or region according to the Customer's policy. Fallbacks can be limited to models approved by Customer in the annex.

(3) Subprocessors
- Processor will maintain an up-to-date subprocessor list and provide 30 days' advance notice for material changes. Subprocessors performing cross-border transfers will be bound by equivalent data protection obligations.

(4) Transfer Safeguards
- Processor relies on SCCs, binding contractual commitments, and documented technical/organizational measures described in the attached DPF evidence pack.

I attached a DPA_Annex_Draft.pdf (redline-ready) and a zipped sample evidence package. Laura, would you mind reviewing the contract language and pushing a clean copy to the Drive folder?

-Karthik
Senior Privacy Engineer
Redwood Inference
